notes: Sourced from AJA's own spec sheet (aja.com/products/hi5-fiber/spec-sheet.pdf) and full Installation and Operation Guide v2.3r1 (aja.com/assets/support/files/9601/en/AJA_Hi5-Fiber_Manual_v2.3r1.pdf), including the panel connector diagram (Figure 2). This is a desktop Mini-Converter, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted/0). It has no SDI BNC connector - video input is exclusively single-mode ST-style fiber (3G/HD/SD-SDI), which distinguishes it from other AJA Hi5 variants (Hi5-12G, Hi5-Plus) that use BNC. Connector-id caveats: (1) the fiber input is an ST-type fiber connector, not LC - fiber-lc was chosen as the closest available id in the allowed connector list; (2) the USB configuration port is physically Mini-USB, not Micro-USB - usb-micro chosen as closest available id since mini-usb is not in the allowed set; no USB speed grade is stated by AJA so no grade was set. HDMI output bit-depth (12-bit/10-bit/8-bit) is specified but AJA does not publish an HDMI spec version (1.4/2.0/2.1) for this model; hdmi-1.4 is an inferred grade based on the 1080p/2K-class-only video format list (no 4K/UHD support), and should be treated as a medium-confidence inference despite the overall high confidence of the port list itself. Power input is a locking DC barrel jack; the panel text ("5-20 VDC") and the tech-spec text ("+5V DC regulated, 3W") describe the same locking connector from two different reference points (supply output range tolerance vs. regulated internal rail) - not two separate ports.

ports.name: Optical In
ports.note: ST-style single-mode 1310nm fiber connector carrying 3G/HD/SD-SDI (SMPTE-259/292/424); closest list match is fiber-lc, actual connector is ST-type, not LC

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: Outputs up to 10-bit YCbCr 4:2:2 / 8-bit RGB 4:4:4 with up to 8 channels embedded audio; spec sheet does not state an HDMI version number, 1.4 inferred from 10/12-bit 1080p-class support

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Physically a Mini-USB port (not listed in connector set); used only for Mini-Config control/firmware, not general data transfer. No speed/grade stated by AJA.

ports.name: Power 5-20 VDC
ports.note: Locking DC barrel connector; panel silkscreen reads 5-20 VDC but AJA's included external supply (model DWP-U-R1) takes 100-240VAC and outputs regulated +5V DC, 3W to the unit
